body.name: \(P^{\rho,s}\)
body.construction:
For \((\rho,s)\in(0,1)^2\), \(P^{\rho,s}\) keeps the four \((D,Z)\)-cell probabilities \((2/25,9/20,9/25,11/100)\) and the uniform outcome laws in the two cells with \(D=0\) from \(P^\star\), while
\[
 Y\mid(D,Z)=(1,0)\sim\operatorname{Beta}(100\rho,100(1-\rho)),
 \qquad
 Y\mid(D,Z)=(1,1)\sim\operatorname{Beta}(20s,20(1-s)).
\]
